title: Thai Kebab Lamb Skewers
description: Grilled lamb skewers with a flavorful Thai-inspired marinade, perfect for a quick and delicious dinner.

ingredients.name: lamb shoulder, cut into 1-inch cubes
ingredients.notes: Make sure to trim any excess fat

ingredients.name: Thai red curry paste
ingredients.notes: You can adjust the level of spiciness to your liking

ingredients.name: fish sauce
ingredients.notes: This adds a salty, umami flavor to the dish

ingredients.name: brown sugar
ingredients.notes: Helps balance out the acidity in the marinade

ingredients.name: lemon juice
ingredients.notes: Freshly squeezed lemon juice adds brightness to the dish

ingredients.name: minced garlic
ingredients.notes: Can be adjusted to your taste

ingredients.name: coconut milk
ingredients.notes: Optional, adds creaminess to the marinade

instructions: In a blender or food processor, combine Thai red curry paste, fish sauce, brown sugar, lemon juice, vegetable oil, minced garlic, and ground cumin. Blend until smooth.
In a large bowl, whisk together the marinade and coconut milk (if using). Add the lamb cubes and mix until they are evenly coated.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Preheat grill to medium-high heat. Thread the marinated lamb onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the grill grates with vegetable oil to prevent sticking. Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until the lamb is cooked to your desired level of doneness.
Transfer the skewers to a plate and garnish with chopped cilantro.
